note: IndicTTS Telugu on the hub is one split of both speakers (female about 4.27 h, male about 4.47 h, 48 kHz). Neither speaker alone has 5 hours, so train and validation both contain female and male. The hub 'train' split is not used as the training set; membership is in this manifest.
chunking_note: Clips longer than max_utt_sec are split on orthographic syllables. Audio time is proportional to characters. A slice is dropped when its transcript is longer than the wav2vec2/MMS CTC frame budget (the failure mode log_probs 140 vs targets 239). Female hub clips are often 16 kHz paragraphs; male clips are often 48 kHz. split_stats train_hours_written and val_hours_written are the real durations. If reached_target is false, do not describe the subset as 5 h / 1 h.
